title: Backend Test Module Compiler
description: Compiles a backend test suite from a behavior spec. Enforces: every behavior scenario has at least one test, no real network calls in unit tests, test isolation (no shared mutable state), typed mocks (no implicit any in mock returns), explicit assertions (not just expect(x).toBeTruthy).

error_codes.BT002: One or more behavior scenarios have no corresponding test
error_codes.BT003: Real network call (fetch, axios, http) in unit test — use MSW or mock
error_codes.BT004: Shared mutable state between tests (module-level variable mutated)
error_codes.BT005: Mock return value typed as any/unknown — use typed mock helper
error_codes.BT006: Weak assertion: toBeTruthy/toBeFalsy/toBeDefined with no value check
